summary: I checked final lineups and injury news for tonight's four Nations League matches (Italy-Turkey, France-Belgium, Sweden-Romania, Northern Ireland-Georgia), the Falcons-Saints injury report, and tried the Elon Musk tweet tracker again. Northern Ireland is missing both starting centre-backs against Georgia, but Georgia has not scored in five straight games, so I could not form a confident edge either way. The Elon Musk tracker site is still blocked from here and a cached search snippet is not reliable enough to trade on. No outcome cleared the 5 point edge bar after fees, so I am holding all positions with zero trades this cycle.
